title: 1.1 Application in Conservation of Natural Resources
description: Renewable and non-renewable resources, biodiversity, protected areas and conservation methods. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? A natural resource that can replenish itself over time
Which term matches this description? A natural resource that forms far slower than it is used
Which term matches this description? The variety of life at genetic, species and ecosystem levels
Which term matches this description? The sustainable use and protection of natural resources
Which term matches this description? Using resources at a rate that allows natural renewal
Which term matches this description? A protected area set aside to conserve species and habitats
Which term matches this description? A protected area managed mainly for ecosystem conservation
Which term matches this description? A protected area dedicated to the safety of wild animals
Which term matches this description? Conserving threatened species outside their natural habitats
Which term matches this description? Protecting species within the ecosystems where they live
Which term matches this description? A facility that stores genetic material of crops and wildlife
Which term matches this description? A store of seeds preserved to maintain plant genetic diversity
Which term matches this description? A species with a high risk of extinction in the wild
Which term matches this description? A species likely to become endangered in the near future
Which term matches this description? The permanent disappearance of a species from Earth
Which term matches this description? The destruction or fragmentation of a species natural home
Which term matches this description? Using a resource faster than it can naturally recover
Which term matches this description? The introduction of harmful substances into the environment
Which term matches this description? Replanting trees in an area that has been deforested
Which term matches this description? A benefit people obtain from functioning ecosystems
